{{figure:fig_8_1.webp}}

The diagrams show the probability density functions of four random variables $W$, $X$, $Y$ and $Z$. Each of the four variables takes values between −3 and 3 only, and their standard deviations are $\sigma_W$, $\sigma_X$, $\sigma_Y$ and $\sigma_Z$ respectively.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: List $\sigma_W$, $\sigma_X$, $\sigma_Y$ and $\sigma_Z$ in order of size, starting with the largest.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
The probability density function of $X$ is given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{18}x^2 & -3 \leqslant x \leqslant 3, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Show that $\sigma_X = 2.32$ correct to 3 significant figures.
